description: Guided ink-brush practice using standard楷书 (regular script) characters; participants work silently at individual desks with provided rice paper, ink, and brushes.
Weekly planting and mulching of native shrubs along the east courtyard walkway; tasks assigned individually, no group coordination required.
Self-paced observation of curated chemical reactions (e.g., crystallization, pH indicators, electrochemical cells); students watch from designated stations without discussion or collaboration.
Monthly screening of restored Chinese silent films (e.g., 'Spring in a Small Town') with live piano accompaniment; attendees sit independently, no post-screening discussion.
Timed 3km route around campus perimeter; participants start together but run at their own pace with personal headphones permitted—no grouping or pacing support.
Structured solo lyric-writing session guided by thematic prompts (e.g., 'unspoken things', 'light through window'); no sharing or critique—only private drafting on provided worksheets.
